loader_assessment: All five leaf names with use-blacklist and all five registered aliases omit insertions. Explicit real module names without use-blacklist retain exact baseline dependencies. Essential SPI LCD, HCI, Wi-Fi, USB gadget, video/DRM shared paths are unchanged. show-depends does not load/unload modules.
snapshot_assessment: Kernel monotonic timings exclude firmware latency; first normal runtime PID bounds boot markers and excludes later manual service restarts. Hotspot readiness requires address plus receive_ready=True; unavailable/late Printer status retained. Current service entry timestamps are separated from first journal boot entries. /proc/modules allocation is current loaded closure, not total RAM savings.
limitations: Root owns live LCD/HIF/FTP/button/reconnect/rollback/reboot acceptance; this review performed no hardware mutation or film commands.
File-content boot report is descriptive, not effective loader enforcement.
Explicit loads and dependencies intentionally may override ordinary blacklist. Kernel builtin drivers or changed aliases/dependencies require re-audit.
